title: Disability Compensation Returned Payments: Recomputed Entitlement, Debt-Withheld Returns and the Replacement Amount
content:
**Rule.** The amount a Disability Compensation replacement pays is set by what the award's records show about the payment that came back:

| What the records show | The replacement pays |
|---|---|
| The gross monthly entitlement the award now carries differs from the gross of the payment that came back | That recomputed entitlement |
| The entitlement is unchanged, but part of the payment that came back had been withheld for a debt, so that less came back than its gross | Only the net amount that came back |
| The entitlement is unchanged and nothing was withheld | The gross amount of the payment that came back, repeated |

"Unchanged" means the entitlement equals the gross of the payment that came back to the cent. The gross and the net that came back are read from the most recent returned-payment entry on the award: the entry shows the gross of the payment and, as a negative figure, the net amount that came back.

**The entitlement the award now carries, for a replacement,** is the individual unemployability rate (3938.58) when the award's decision history shows individual unemployability granted, and the veteran-alone rate of the award's combined rating otherwise; plus one SMC (k) addition (139.87) for each SMC (k) award on the award, up to the SMC (k) maximum of 3; plus the spouse, child and parent additions counted in the replacement. Every addition is taken from the 100 percent tier when individual unemployability is granted — spouse 220.30, spouse aid and attendance 201.41, child 146.10, school child 472.95, parent 176.88 — and from the award's own tier otherwise. Amounts are added to the cent.

**Worked cases (hypothetical awards)**

1. *Entitlement changed.* The award carries Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating), no individual unemployability, no SMC (k), and a spouse is counted: 1132.90 plus 110.15, that is 1243.05. The payment that came back had a gross of 1132.90. The two differ, so the replacement pays 1243.05.
2. *Unchanged, debt withheld.* The entitlement is 1435.02; the payment that came back had a gross of 1435.02 of which 200.00 had been withheld for a debt, so 1235.02 came back. The replacement pays 1235.02.
3. *Unchanged, nothing withheld.* The entitlement is 795.84; the payment that came back had a gross of 795.84 and 795.84 came back. The replacement pays 795.84.
4. *Individual unemployability on record.* An award at Disability Compensation (70% Combined Rating) whose decision history shows individual unemployability granted, with 1 SMC (k) award and no dependents counted, carries 3938.58 plus 139.87, that is 4078.45.
